shortDesc: Code snippet sharing platform tailored for competitive programmers.
fullDesc:
A utility platform designed for competitive programmers to share solutions, codes, and logic snippets instantly.

Core Idea:
CP Share solves the friction of sharing competitive programming solutions by allowing users to capture their editor active buffer, format it automatically, and generate lightweight sharing links. It supports code syntax highlighting and editor integrations.
highlights: One-click sharing for competitive programming codebases
Preserves indentation, language detection, and styling
